description: Golden test vectors for bill split and receipt validation maths. The backend (backend/app/core) and the frontend mirror (frontend/src/lib/split) must both reproduce every 'expected' block exactly.

rules.money: Integer cents everywhere. Weights are decimal strings.
rules.allocate: allocate(total, weights): share_i = ROUND_HALF_UP(total * w_i / sum(w)) (halves away from zero; 0 if sum(w) == 0); then remainder = total - sum(shares) is added to the LARGEST share (the first one on ties).

item_modes.single: first share's person pays the whole item
item_modes.weighted: allocate(item_total, weights) (percentages, 'by shares', quick split by shares)
item_modes.custom: amount_cents used as given; if they don't sum to the item total an issue is reported
item_modes.null: unassigned (also: no valid shares, or all weights 0)

rules.bill: items_cents[p] = sum of p's item shares; totals = allocate(grand_total, items_cents in participant order). Unassigned items are excluded. Shares for non-participants are ignored (issue).
rules.quick_split: a single synthetic item whose total is the grand total, mode equal or weighted
rules.is_complete: participants exist and there are no issues (unassigned items are issues)

legacy_frontend_note: Cases with a 'legacy_frontend' block are where the old float implementation (useCalculations.ts) differs: it only fixed rounding differences larger than 0.01, so it could leave the sum 1 cent off the grand total, and Math.round(x*100) misrounds some half-cents (e.g. 5.005). The 'expected' values are the contract.

split_cases.description: Each item to one person; no charges.
B is on the bill but has no items.
Only one participant pays the whole grand total.
Equal split, divides evenly.
10.00 split 3 ways: the extra cent goes to the first share.
20.00 split 3 ways: shares round up to 6.67, the first absorbs -1c.
100.00 among 7: half-up shares 14.29, first share absorbs -3c (legacy rule).
Shared starter between A and B, mains single.
Custom amounts that add up to the item total.
Custom amounts short of the item total: used as given, issue reported.
Percentage split 60/40.
By shares 2:1:1.
All-zero weights: item treated as unassigned, issue reported.
Subtotal 30.00 + 10% service + 9% GST on top = 35.97.
Mixed modes; service + GST + member discount.
Prices already include GST; items add up to the grand total.
Tax-inclusive with an equal-split item.
A 5.00 discount spreads proportionally.
A negative item line (promo) shared equally.
10.00 equal 3 ways, grand 11.01: largest share gives back 1c.
1:2:3 subtotals, grand 7.01: half-up gives 7.02, C (largest) absorbs -1c.
Equal subtotals, grand 10.01: both round to 5.01, the first gives back 1c.
Unassigned items don't count; grand is spread over assigned items.
C is on the bill but owes nothing.
Free items: everyone owes 0.
Nothing assigned: the remainder rule gives the total to the first person.
Assigned items are all 0.00 but a 2.00 charge exists.
No participants: nothing to compute, issue reported.
A share for someone not on the bill is ignored.
Quick split 100.00 equally among 3 (synthetic item).
Quick split 90.00 by shares 2:1.
Quick split 50.00 by shares 3:2:2.
Large amounts stay exact.

validation_cases.description: Subtotal printed; items match; subtotal + charges = grand.
Items don't add up to the printed subtotal.
No subtotal, no charges, items == grand.
No subtotal, no charges, items != grand.
Items == grand although taxes are listed (prices include tax).
Items match neither the grand total nor grand - charges.
qty x unit != line total: warning only, still ok.
